```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pre_end    <- as.Date("2025-06-30")
```

---

# Study cohort construction

```{r study-cohort-construction}

study <- thoracic_data %>%
  mutate(
    INIT_DATE = as.Date(INIT_DATE),
    END_DATE = as.Date(END_DATE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    WL_ORG == "HR",
    INIT_AGE >= 18,
    (INIT_DATE >= pre_start & INIT_DATE <= pre_end) |
      (INIT_DATE >= post_start & INIT_DATE <= post_end)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    policy_group = case_when(
      INIT_DATE >= pre_start & INIT_DATE <= pre_end ~ "Pre",
      INIT_DATE >= post_start & INIT_DATE <= post_end ~ "Post",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    policy_group = factor(
      policy_group,
      levels = c("Pre", "Post")
    )
  )


study %>%
  count(policy_group)


study %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min_listing_date = min(INIT_DATE, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_listing_date = max(INIT_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


study %>%
  count(
    policy_group,
    INIT_STAT
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    policy_group,
    INIT_STAT
  ) %>%
  print(
    n = Inf
  )
```

# Administrative form exclusions

```{r administrative-form-exclusions}

invalid_form_statuses <- c(
  "Not Required - Withdrawn",
  "Not Required - Listing Error",
  "Not Required - Other"
)
```

# Initial Status 2 pathways

```{r initial-status2-pathways}

initial_status2_flags <- thoracic_stat2 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT),
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT = as.Date(UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT),

    standard_status2_iabp =
      (EXCEPTION %in% 0) &
      (CRITERIAIABPSUPPORT %in% 1),

    standard_status2_pevad =
      (EXCEPTION %in% 0) &
      (CRITERIAMCSDENDOVASSUPP %in% 1),

    standard_status2_iabp_pevad =
      standard_status2_iabp |
      standard_status2_pevad,

    status2_exception =
      EXCEPTION %in% 1
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        INIT_STAT,
        policy_group
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    INIT_STAT == 2120,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2120,
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE,
    policy_group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    standard_status2_iabp =
      any(standard_status2_iabp, na.rm = TRUE),

    standard_status2_pevad =
      any(standard_status2_pevad, na.rm = TRUE),

    standard_status2_iabp_pevad =
      any(standard_status2_iabp_pevad, na.rm = TRUE),

    status2_exception =
      any(status2_exception, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


initial_status2_flags %>%
  group_by(policy_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matched = n(),

    n_standard_iabp =
      sum(standard_status2_iabp),

    n_standard_pevad =
      sum(standard_status2_pevad),

    n_standard_iabp_pevad =
      sum(standard_status2_iabp_pevad),

    n_exception =
      sum(status2_exception),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(
    width = Inf
  )
```

``` {r identifying tMCS at initial listing}
# ============================================================
# Actual IABP, left-sided PEVAD, and VA-ECMO support
# at initial listing
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Standalone thoracic MCS device file
#
# IABP:
#   DEVICE_TYPE == "IABP"
#
# PEVAD:
#   DEVICE_TYPE == "Percutaneous Device"
#   AND VENTRICULAR_SUPPORT == "Left"
#
# VA-ECMO:
#   DEVICE_TYPE == "VA ECMO"
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mcs_device_at_listing <- thoracic_mcs_device %>%
  mutate(
    IMPLANT_DATE = as.Date(IMPLANT_DATE),
    EXPLANT_DATE = as.Date(EXPLANT_DATE)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (
      DEVICE_TYPE == "IABP" |
        (
          DEVICE_TYPE == "Percutaneous Device" &
            VENTRICULAR_SUPPORT == "Left"
        ) |
        DEVICE_TYPE == "VA ECMO"
    ),
    IMPLANT_DATE <= INIT_DATE,
    is.na(EXPLANT_DATE) |
      EXPLANT_DATE >= INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    iabp_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "IABP",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    pevad_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "Percutaneous Device" &
          VENTRICULAR_SUPPORT == "Left",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    va_ecmo_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "VA ECMO",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Status-form device information
#
# Device type IDs:
# 8  = IABP
# 11 = Percutaneous Device
#
# NOTE:
# We retain the existing status-form PEVAD ascertainment here.
# We should separately verify the coding of
# PRIM_VENTRICULARSUPPORTID and SEC_VENTRICULARSUPPORTID
# before imposing a left-sided restriction on these fields.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

status_device_data <- bind_rows(

  thoracic_stat1 %>%
    select(
      WL_ID_CODE,
      FORMEFFECTIVEDT,
      FORMSTATUS,
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID,
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT,
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID,
      SEC_IMPLANTDT
    ),

  thoracic_stat2 %>%
    select(
      WL_ID_CODE,
      FORMEFFECTIVEDT,
      FORMSTATUS,
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID,
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT,
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID,
      SEC_IMPLANTDT
    ),

  thoracic_stat3 %>%
    select(
      WL_ID_CODE,
      FORMEFFECTIVEDT,
      FORMSTATUS,
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID,
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT,
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID,
      SEC_IMPLANTDT
    ),

  thoracic_stat4 %>%
    select(
      WL_ID_CODE,
      FORMEFFECTIVEDT,
      FORMSTATUS,
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID,
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT,
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID,
      SEC_IMPLANTDT
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT),
    PRIM_IMPLANTDT = as.Date(PRIM_IMPLANTDT),
    SEC_IMPLANTDT = as.Date(SEC_IMPLANTDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prim_iabp =
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID == 8 &
      !is.na(PRIM_IMPLANTDT) &
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT <= INIT_DATE,

    sec_iabp =
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID == 8 &
      !is.na(SEC_IMPLANTDT) &
      SEC_IMPLANTDT <= INIT_DATE,

    prim_pevad =
      PRIM_DEVICETYPEID == 11 &
      !is.na(PRIM_IMPLANTDT) &
      PRIM_IMPLANTDT <= INIT_DATE,

    sec_pevad =
      SEC_DEVICETYPEID == 11 &
      !is.na(SEC_IMPLANTDT) &
      SEC_IMPLANTDT <= INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    iabp_status_form =
      any(
        prim_iabp |
          sec_iabp,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    pevad_status_form =
      any(
        prim_pevad |
          sec_pevad,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine standalone MCS and status-form device sources
# ------------------------------------------------------------

device_at_listing <- study %>%
  select(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE,
    policy_group
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    mcs_device_at_listing,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    status_device_data,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        iabp_mcs_file,
        pevad_mcs_file,
        va_ecmo_mcs_file,
        iabp_status_form,
        pevad_status_form
      ),
      ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)
    ),

    # IABP from either source
    iabp_at_listing =
      iabp_mcs_file |
      iabp_status_form,

    # PEVAD from either source
    pevad_at_listing =
      pevad_mcs_file |
      pevad_status_form,

    # VA-ECMO from standalone MCS device file
    va_ecmo_at_listing =
      va_ecmo_mcs_file,

    # Preserve this outcome specifically for the Status 2
    # IABP/PEVAD policy analysis
    any_iabp_pevad_at_listing =
      iabp_at_listing |
      pevad_at_listing,

    # Broader temporary-MCS outcome
    any_temporary_mcs_at_listing =
      iabp_at_listing |
      pevad_at_listing |
      va_ecmo_at_listing
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary by policy era
# ------------------------------------------------------------

device_at_listing %>%
  group_by(policy_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    n_iabp =
      sum(iabp_at_listing),

    pct_iabp =
      100 * mean(iabp_at_listing),

    n_pevad =
      sum(pevad_at_listing),

    pct_pevad =
      100 * mean(pevad_at_listing),

    n_va_ecmo =
      sum(va_ecmo_at_listing),

    pct_va_ecmo =
      100 * mean(va_ecmo_at_listing),

    n_any_iabp_pevad =
      sum(any_iabp_pevad_at_listing),

    pct_any_iabp_pevad =
      100 * mean(any_iabp_pevad_at_listing),

    n_any_temporary_mcs =
      sum(any_temporary_mcs_at_listing),

    pct_any_temporary_mcs =
      100 * mean(any_temporary_mcs_at_listing),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(
    width = Inf
  )
  
```

# Construct primary analytic data set

```{r construct-study-analysis}

# Construct primary analytic data set


study_analysis <- study %>%
  mutate(
    initial_status1 =
      INIT_STAT == 2110,

    initial_status2 =
      INIT_STAT == 2120,

    initial_status3 =
      INIT_STAT == 2130,

    initial_status1_or_2 =
      INIT_STAT %in% c(
        2110,
        2120
      )
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    initial_status1_flags %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        standard_status1_ecmo,
        status1_exception
      ),
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    initial_status2_flags %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        standard_status2_iabp,
        standard_status2_pevad,
        standard_status2_iabp_pevad,
        status2_exception
      ),
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    initial_status3_flags %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        standard_status3_hd_inotrope,
        status3_exception
      ),
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    device_at_listing %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        iabp_at_listing,
        pevad_at_listing,
        va_ecmo_at_listing,
        any_iabp_pevad_at_listing,
        any_temporary_mcs_at_listing
      ),
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        standard_status1_ecmo,
        status1_exception,
        standard_status2_iabp,
        standard_status2_pevad,
        standard_status2_iabp_pevad,
        status2_exception,
        standard_status3_hd_inotrope,
        status3_exception,
        iabp_at_listing,
        pevad_at_listing,
        va_ecmo_at_listing,
        any_iabp_pevad_at_listing,
        any_temporary_mcs_at_listing
      ),
      ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)
    ),

    status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad =
      status2_exception &
      any_iabp_pevad_at_listing,

    status2_exception_without_iabp_pevad =
      status2_exception &
      !any_iabp_pevad_at_listing
  )


```

# Pre/post tests for allocation pathways

```{r allocation-pathway-tests}

allocation_outcomes <- c(
  "initial_status1",
  "initial_status2",
  "initial_status1_or_2",

  "standard_status1_ecmo",
  "status1_exception",

  "standard_status2_iabp",
  "standard_status2_pevad",
  "standard_status2_iabp_pevad",
  "status2_exception",
  "status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad",
  "status2_exception_without_iabp_pevad",

  "standard_status3_hd_inotrope",

  "iabp_at_listing",
  "pevad_at_listing",
  "va_ecmo_at_listing",
  "any_iabp_pevad_at_listing",
  "any_temporary_mcs_at_listing"
)


allocation_test_results <- map_dfr(
  allocation_outcomes,
  function(v) {

    tab <- table(
      study_analysis$policy_group,
      study_analysis[[v]]
    )

    test <- chisq.test(tab)

    n_pre <- sum(
      study_analysis$policy_group == "Pre" &
        study_analysis[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    n_post <- sum(
      study_analysis$policy_group == "Post" &
        study_analysis[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    denom_pre <- sum(
      study_analysis$policy_group == "Pre"
    )

    denom_post <- sum(
      study_analysis$policy_group == "Post"
    )

    tibble(
      outcome = v,

      n_pre = n_pre,
      pct_pre = 100 * n_pre / denom_pre,

      n_post = n_post,
      pct_post = 100 * n_post / denom_post,

      absolute_change_pp =
        pct_post - pct_pre,

      chi_square =
        unname(test$statistic),

      p_value =
        test$p.value
    )
  }
)


print(
  allocation_test_results,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

```

# Initial-listing inotrope data

```{r initial-listing-inotrope-data}

# ============================================================
# Initial-Listing Inotrope Exposure
# ============================================================

initial_inotrope_data <- thoracic_wlhistory_data %>%
  mutate(
    CHANGEDATE = as.Date(CHANGEDATE)
  ) %>%

  inner_join(
    study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        INIT_STAT,
        policy_group
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%

  filter(
    CHANGEDATE == INIT_DATE,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == INIT_STAT
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE,
    INIT_STAT,
    policy_group
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    vasoactive_support =
      case_when(
        any(
          CURRTHERVASOACTIVESUPPORT == "Y",
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) ~ "Y",

        any(
          CURRTHERVASOACTIVESUPPORT == "N",
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) ~ "N",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

    dobutamine =
      if (
        all(is.na(CURRTHERDOBUTAMINE))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(
          CURRTHERDOBUTAMINE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },

    dopamine =
      if (
        all(is.na(CURRTHERDOPAMINE))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(
          CURRTHERDOPAMINE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },

    milrinone =
      if (
        all(is.na(CURRTHERMILRINONE))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(
          CURRTHERMILRINONE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },

    epinephrine =
      if (
        all(is.na(CURRTHEREPINEPHRINE))
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        max(
          CURRTHEREPINEPHRINE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Any of the Four Study Inotropes Documented
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    any_inotrope_documented =
      coalesce(
        dobutamine > 0,
        FALSE
      ) |
      coalesce(
        dopamine > 0,
        FALSE
      ) |
      coalesce(
        milrinone > 0,
        FALSE
      ) |
      coalesce(
        epinephrine > 0,
        FALSE
      ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Single High-Dose Status 3 Thresholds
    #
    # Dobutamine >= 7.5 mcg/kg/min
    # Milrinone >= 0.50 mcg/kg/min
    # Epinephrine >= 0.02 mcg/kg/min
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    single_high_dose =
      coalesce(
        dobutamine >= 7.5,
        FALSE
      ) |
      coalesce(
        milrinone >= 0.50,
        FALSE
      ) |
      coalesce(
        epinephrine >= 0.02,
        FALSE
      ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Multiple-Inotrope Status 3 Thresholds
    #
    # At Least 2 of:
    # Dobutamine >= 3 mcg/kg/min
    # Dopamine >= 3 mcg/kg/min
    # Milrinone >= 0.25 mcg/kg/min
    # Epinephrine >= 0.01 mcg/kg/min
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    n_multiple_threshold_drugs =
      as.integer(
        coalesce(
          dobutamine >= 3,
          FALSE
        )
      ) +
      as.integer(
        coalesce(
          dopamine >= 3,
          FALSE
        )
      ) +
      as.integer(
        coalesce(
          milrinone >= 0.25,
          FALSE
        )
      ) +
      as.integer(
        coalesce(
          epinephrine >= 0.01,
          FALSE
        )
      ),

    multiple_inotrope_threshold =
      n_multiple_threshold_drugs >= 2,

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Meets Either Status 3 Inotrope-Dose Pathway
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    meets_hd_inotrope_dose =
      single_high_dose |
      multiple_inotrope_threshold,

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Mutually Exclusive Inotrope Categories
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    inotrope_category =
      case_when(
        meets_hd_inotrope_dose ~
          "Meets Status 3 Dose Threshold",

        any_inotrope_documented ~
          "Inotropes Documented below Status 3 Threshold",

        TRUE ~
          "No Inotropes Documented"
      )
  )


```

# Primary inotrope hypothesis

The primary hypothesis is whether, after the policy change, a greater proportion of all newly listed candidates entered each high-priority pathway **without meeting Status 3 inotrope-dose criteria**.

Bonferroni correction is applied across the three primary pathway-specific comparisons.

```{r primary-inotrope-hypothesis}

primary_inotrope_test_data <- study_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    s1_ecmo_without_status3_inotropes =
      standard_status1_ecmo &
      !meets_hd_inotrope_dose,

    s1_exception_without_status3_inotropes =
      status1_exception &
      !meets_hd_inotrope_dose,

    s2_exception_device_without_status3_inotropes =
      status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad &
      !meets_hd_inotrope_dose
  )


primary_inotrope_outcomes <- c(
  "s1_ecmo_without_status3_inotropes",
  "s1_exception_without_status3_inotropes",
  "s2_exception_device_without_status3_inotropes"
)


primary_inotrope_labels <- c(
  s1_ecmo_without_status3_inotropes =
    "Status 1 ECMO - Does Not Meet Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold",

  s1_exception_without_status3_inotropes =
    "Status 1 Exception - Does Not Meet Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold",

  s2_exception_device_without_status3_inotropes =
    "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD - Does Not Meet Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold"
)


primary_inotrope_results <- map_dfr(
  primary_inotrope_outcomes,
  function(v) {

    tab <- table(
      primary_inotrope_test_data$policy_group,
      primary_inotrope_test_data[[v]]
    )

    test <- chisq.test(
      tab
    )

    n_pre <- sum(
      primary_inotrope_test_data$policy_group == "Pre" &
        primary_inotrope_test_data[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    n_post <- sum(
      primary_inotrope_test_data$policy_group == "Post" &
        primary_inotrope_test_data[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    denom_pre <- sum(
      primary_inotrope_test_data$policy_group == "Pre"
    )

    denom_post <- sum(
      primary_inotrope_test_data$policy_group == "Post"
    )

    tibble(
      outcome =
        primary_inotrope_labels[[v]],

      n_pre =
        n_pre,

      pct_pre =
        100 * n_pre / denom_pre,

      n_post =
        n_post,

      pct_post =
        100 * n_post / denom_post,

      absolute_change_pp =
        pct_post - pct_pre,

      relative_change_pct =
        100 *
        (
          (pct_post / pct_pre) - 1
        ),

      chi_square =
        unname(
          test$statistic
        ),

      p_value =
        test$p.value
    )
  }
) %>%

  mutate(
    p_bonferroni =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "bonferroni"
      ),

    significant_bonferroni =
      p_bonferroni < 0.05
  )


print(
  primary_inotrope_results,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)


```

# Secondary inotrope hypothesis

The secondary hypothesis is whether the proportion of all newly listed candidates who **did meet Status 3 inotrope-dose criteria** and nevertheless entered each high-priority pathway changed after the policy.

Bonferroni correction is applied across the three secondary pathway-specific comparisons.

```{r secondary-inotrope-hypothesis}


secondary_test_data <- study_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    s1_ecmo_meets_status3 =
      standard_status1_ecmo &
      meets_hd_inotrope_dose,

    s1_exception_meets_status3 =
      status1_exception &
      meets_hd_inotrope_dose,

    s2_exception_device_meets_status3 =
      status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad &
      meets_hd_inotrope_dose
  )


secondary_outcomes <- c(
  "s1_ecmo_meets_status3",
  "s1_exception_meets_status3",
  "s2_exception_device_meets_status3"
)


secondary_labels <- c(
  s1_ecmo_meets_status3 =
    "Status 1 ECMO - Meets Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold",

  s1_exception_meets_status3 =
    "Status 1 Exception - Meets Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold",

  s2_exception_device_meets_status3 =
    "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD - Meets Status 3 Inotrope Dose Threshold"
)


secondary_results <- map_dfr(
  secondary_outcomes,
  function(v) {

    tab <- table(
      secondary_test_data$policy_group,
      secondary_test_data[[v]]
    )

    test <- chisq.test(
      tab
    )

    n_pre <- sum(
      secondary_test_data$policy_group == "Pre" &
        secondary_test_data[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    n_post <- sum(
      secondary_test_data$policy_group == "Post" &
        secondary_test_data[[v]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    denom_pre <- sum(
      secondary_test_data$policy_group == "Pre"
    )

    denom_post <- sum(
      secondary_test_data$policy_group == "Post"
    )

    tibble(
      outcome =
        secondary_labels[[v]],

      n_pre =
        n_pre,

      pct_pre =
        100 * n_pre / denom_pre,

      n_post =
        n_post,

      pct_post =
        100 * n_post / denom_post,

      absolute_change_pp =
        pct_post - pct_pre,

      relative_change_pct =
        100 *
        (
          (pct_post / pct_pre) - 1
        ),

      chi_square =
        unname(
          test$statistic
        ),

      p_value =
        test$p.value
    )
  }
) %>%

  mutate(
    p_bonferroni =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "bonferroni"
      ),

    significant_bonferroni =
      p_bonferroni < 0.05
  )


print(
  secondary_results,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```

# Absolute-count inotrope figure

```{r making the inotrope figure! aka figure 2}


# ============================================================
# Build Annotation Data
# ============================================================

comparison_annotation_data <- absolute_inotrope_plot_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(
      policy_group,
      inotrope_category
    ),
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pre_meets =
      `Pre_Meets Status 3 Dose Threshold`,

    post_meets =
      `Post_Meets Status 3 Dose Threshold`,

    pre_below =
      `Pre_Inotropes Documented below Status 3 Threshold`,

    post_below =
      `Post_Inotropes Documented below Status 3 Threshold`,

    pre_none =
      `Pre_No Inotropes Documented`,

    post_none =
      `Post_No Inotropes Documented`,

    pre_total =
      pre_meets +
      pre_below +
      pre_none,

    post_total =
      post_meets +
      post_below +
      post_none,

    pre_meets_mid =
      pre_meets / 2,

    post_meets_mid =
      post_meets / 2,

    pre_not_meets_mid =
      pre_meets +
      (pre_below + pre_none) / 2,

    post_not_meets_mid =
      post_meets +
      (post_below + post_none) / 2,

    bracket_gap_pre =
      0.05 * pre_total,

    bracket_gap_post =
      0.05 * post_total,

    pre_bracket_x =
      1.40,

    pre_tick_x =
      1.35,

    post_bracket_x =
      1.60,

    post_tick_x =
      1.65
  )


# ============================================================
# Add Primary Significance Results
# ============================================================

primary_labels <- primary_inotrope_results %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_group = case_when(
      grepl(
        "Status 1 ECMO",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 1 ECMO",

      grepl(
        "Status 1 Exception",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 1 Exception",

      grepl(
        "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD"
    ),

    primary_sig =
      ifelse(
        significant_bonferroni,
        "*",
        ""
      )
  ) %>%
  select(
    analysis_group,
    primary_sig
  )


# ============================================================
# Add Secondary Significance Results
# ============================================================

secondary_labels <- secondary_results %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_group = case_when(
      grepl(
        "Status 1 ECMO",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 1 ECMO",

      grepl(
        "Status 1 Exception",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 1 Exception",

      grepl(
        "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD",
        outcome
      ) ~ "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD"
    ),

    secondary_sig =
      ifelse(
        significant_bonferroni,
        "*",
        ""
      )
  ) %>%
  select(
    analysis_group,
    secondary_sig
  )


comparison_annotation_data <- comparison_annotation_data %>%
  left_join(
    primary_labels,
    by = "analysis_group"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    secondary_labels,
    by = "analysis_group"
  )


# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

absolute_inotrope_plot <- ggplot(
  absolute_inotrope_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = policy_group,
    y = n,
    fill = inotrope_category
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.70
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = n
    ),
    position = position_stack(
      vjust = 0.5
    ),
    size = 5
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ analysis_group,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(
      c(
        "Status 1 ECMO" =
          "Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO",

        "Status 1 Exception" =
          "Status 1 Exception",

        "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD" =
          "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD"
      )
    )
  ) +

  # ==========================================================
  # LOWER BRACKETS
  # Meets Status 3 High-Dose Threshold
  # ==========================================================

  # Pre lower bracket
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_bracket_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = 0,
      yend = pre_meets - bracket_gap_pre / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_tick_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_tick_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = pre_meets - bracket_gap_pre / 2,
      yend = pre_meets - bracket_gap_pre / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Post lower bracket
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_bracket_x,
      y = 0,
      yend = post_meets - bracket_gap_post / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_tick_x,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_tick_x,
      y = post_meets - bracket_gap_post / 2,
      yend = post_meets - bracket_gap_post / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Lower comparison line
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = 1.43,
      xend = 1.57,
      y = pre_meets_mid,
      yend = post_meets_mid
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Secondary significance
  geom_text(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = 1.50,
      y =
        pmax(
          pre_meets_mid,
          post_meets_mid
        ) +
        0.04 * pmax(
          pre_total,
          post_total
        ),
      label = secondary_sig
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # ==========================================================
  # UPPER BRACKETS
  # Does Not Meet Status 3 High-Dose Threshold
  # ==========================================================

  # Pre upper bracket
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_bracket_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = pre_meets + bracket_gap_pre / 2,
      yend = pre_total
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_tick_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = pre_meets + bracket_gap_pre / 2,
      yend = pre_meets + bracket_gap_pre / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = pre_tick_x,
      xend = pre_bracket_x,
      y = pre_total,
      yend = pre_total
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Post upper bracket
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_bracket_x,
      y = post_meets + bracket_gap_post / 2,
      yend = post_total
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_tick_x,
      y = post_meets + bracket_gap_post / 2,
      yend = post_meets + bracket_gap_post / 2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = post_bracket_x,
      xend = post_tick_x,
      y = post_total,
      yend = post_total
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Upper comparison line
  geom_segment(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = 1.43,
      xend = 1.57,
      y = pre_not_meets_mid,
      yend = post_not_meets_mid
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Primary significance
  geom_text(
    data = comparison_annotation_data,
    aes(
      x = 1.50,
      y =
        pmax(
          pre_not_meets_mid,
          post_not_meets_mid
        ) +
        0.04 * pmax(
          pre_total,
          post_total
        ),
      label = primary_sig
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # ==========================================================
  # Colors and Theme
  # ==========================================================

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "No Inotropes Documented" =
        "#79af97",

      "Inotropes Documented below Status 3 Threshold" =
        "#df8f44",

      "Meets Status 3 Dose Threshold" =
        "#00a1d5"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "No Inotropes Documented",
      "Inotropes Documented below Status 3 Threshold",
      "Meets Status 3 Dose Threshold"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "No Inotropic Support Documented",
      "Inotropic Support Below Status 3 High-Dose Threshold",
      "Meets Status 3 High-Dose Threshold"
    )
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Candidates",
    fill = "Inotrope Therapy at Initial Listing"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 13
      ),

    axis.text =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    legend.position =
      "bottom",

    legend.title =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      )
  )


print(
  absolute_inotrope_plot
)
```

``` {r creating figure 1}


# ============================================================
# 1. Continuous Figure Cohort
# September 1, 2024 through June 30, 2026
# ============================================================

figure_start <- as.Date("2024-09-01")
figure_end   <- as.Date("2026-06-30")


figure_study <- thoracic_data %>%
  mutate(
    INIT_DATE = as.Date(INIT_DATE),
    END_DATE = as.Date(END_DATE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    WL_ORG == "HR",
    INIT_AGE >= 18,
    INIT_DATE >= figure_start,
    INIT_DATE <= figure_end
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Initial Status 1 Pathways
# ============================================================

figure_status1_flags <- thoracic_stat1 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    figure_study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        INIT_STAT
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    INIT_STAT == 2110,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2110,
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    standard_status1_ecmo =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0 &
          CRITERIAECMOSUPPORT == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    status1_exception =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Initial Status 2 Pathways
# ============================================================

figure_status2_flags <- thoracic_stat2 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    figure_study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        INIT_STAT
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    INIT_STAT == 2120,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2120,
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    standard_status2_iabp =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0 &
          CRITERIAIABPSUPPORT == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    standard_status2_pevad =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0 &
          CRITERIAMCSDENDOVASSUPP == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    standard_status2_iabp_pevad =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0 &
          (
            CRITERIAIABPSUPPORT == 1 |
              CRITERIAMCSDENDOVASSUPP == 1
          ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    status2_exception =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Initial Status 3 High-Dose Inotrope Pathway
# ============================================================

figure_status3_flags <- thoracic_stat3 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    figure_study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE,
        INIT_STAT
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    INIT_STAT == 2130,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2130,
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    standard_status3_hd_inotrope =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0 &
          CRITERIAINOTROPESUPPORT == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. IABP/PEVAD Support Recorded on Status Forms
# ============================================================

figure_status_form_devices <- bind_rows(
  thoracic_stat1,
  thoracic_stat2,
  thoracic_stat3,
  thoracic_stat4
) %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    figure_study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT == INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    iabp_status_form =
      any(
        PRIM_DEVICETYPEID == 8 |
          SEC_DEVICETYPEID == 8,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    pevad_status_form =
      any(
        PRIM_DEVICETYPEID == 11 |
          SEC_DEVICETYPEID == 11,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Device Support from MCS File
# ============================================================

figure_mcs_devices <- thoracic_mcs_device %>%
  mutate(
    IMPLANT_DATE = as.Date(IMPLANT_DATE),
    EXPLANT_DATE = as.Date(EXPLANT_DATE)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    figure_study %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        INIT_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (
      DEVICE_TYPE == "IABP" |
        (
          DEVICE_TYPE == "Percutaneous Device" &
            VENTRICULAR_SUPPORT == "Left"
        ) |
        DEVICE_TYPE == "VA ECMO"
    ),
    IMPLANT_DATE <= INIT_DATE,
    is.na(EXPLANT_DATE) |
      EXPLANT_DATE >= INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE,
    INIT_DATE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    iabp_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "IABP",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    pevad_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "Percutaneous Device" &
          VENTRICULAR_SUPPORT == "Left",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    va_ecmo_mcs_file =
      any(
        DEVICE_TYPE == "VA ECMO",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Construct Continuous Figure Analysis Dataset
# ============================================================

figure_analysis <- figure_study %>%
  
  left_join(
    figure_status1_flags,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    figure_status2_flags,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    figure_status3_flags,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    figure_status_form_devices,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    figure_mcs_devices,
    by = c(
      "WL_ID_CODE",
      "INIT_DATE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    standard_status1_ecmo =
      coalesce(
        standard_status1_ecmo,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    status1_exception =
      coalesce(
        status1_exception,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    standard_status2_iabp =
      coalesce(
        standard_status2_iabp,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    standard_status2_pevad =
      coalesce(
        standard_status2_pevad,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    standard_status2_iabp_pevad =
      coalesce(
        standard_status2_iabp_pevad,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    status2_exception =
      coalesce(
        status2_exception,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    standard_status3_hd_inotrope =
      coalesce(
        standard_status3_hd_inotrope,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    iabp_mcs_file =
      coalesce(
        iabp_mcs_file,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    pevad_mcs_file =
      coalesce(
        pevad_mcs_file,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    va_ecmo_mcs_file =
      coalesce(
        va_ecmo_mcs_file,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    iabp_status_form =
      coalesce(
        iabp_status_form,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    pevad_status_form =
      coalesce(
        pevad_status_form,
        FALSE
      ),
    
    iabp_at_listing =
      iabp_mcs_file |
      iabp_status_form,
    
    pevad_at_listing =
      pevad_mcs_file |
      pevad_status_form,
    
    va_ecmo_at_listing =
      va_ecmo_mcs_file,
    
    any_iabp_pevad_at_listing =
      iabp_at_listing |
      pevad_at_listing,
    
    status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad =
      status2_exception &
      any_iabp_pevad_at_listing,
    
    status2_exception_without_iabp_pevad =
      status2_exception &
      !any_iabp_pevad_at_listing
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. Monthly Figure Data
# ============================================================

figure_months <- seq(
  as.Date("2024-09-01"),
  as.Date("2026-06-01"),
  by = "1 month"
)


monthly_pathway_data <- figure_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    listing_month =
      floor_date(
        INIT_DATE,
        unit = "month"
      )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    listing_month
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    `Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO` =
      sum(
        standard_status1_ecmo,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 1 Exception` =
      sum(
        status1_exception,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 2 Standard IABP` =
      sum(
        standard_status2_iabp,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 2 Standard PEVAD` =
      sum(
        standard_status2_pevad,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD` =
      sum(
        status2_exception_with_iabp_pevad,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD` =
      sum(
        status2_exception_without_iabp_pevad,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    `Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes` =
      sum(
        standard_status3_hd_inotrope,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    any_iabp_pevad =
      sum(
        any_iabp_pevad_at_listing,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    va_ecmo =
      sum(
        va_ecmo_at_listing,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Ensure all months are represented
  tidyr::complete(
    listing_month = figure_months,
    fill = list(
      `Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO` = 0,
      `Status 1 Exception` = 0,
      `Status 2 Standard IABP` = 0,
      `Status 2 Standard PEVAD` = 0,
      `Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD` = 0,
      `Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD` = 0,
      `Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes` = 0,
      any_iabp_pevad = 0,
      va_ecmo = 0
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    listing_month
  ) %>%

  # Equal-distance x-axis position
  mutate(
    month_index =
      match(
        listing_month,
        figure_months
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. Long-Format Pathway Data
# ============================================================

pathway_order <- c(
  "Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO",
  "Status 1 Exception",
  "Status 2 Standard IABP",
  "Status 2 Standard PEVAD",
  "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD",
  "Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD",
  "Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes"
)


monthly_pathway_long <- monthly_pathway_data %>%
  select(
    listing_month,
    month_index,
    all_of(
      pathway_order
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(
      pathway_order
    ),
    names_to = "pathway",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = factor(
      pathway,
      levels = pathway_order
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Main Figure
# ============================================================
#
# Month positions:
#
# Sep 2024 = 1
# ...
# Jun 2025 = 10
# Jul 2025 = 11
# Aug 2025 = 12
# Sep 2025 = 13
# Oct 2025 = 14
# ...
# Jun 2026 = 22
#
# Shading begins halfway after September in each matched window,
# approximating the September 17 start date.
#
# Policy line is placed between Sep 2025 and Oct 2025.
# ============================================================


monthly_allocation_plot <- ggplot() +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Pre-policy matched window
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 1.5,
    xmax = 10.5,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 250,
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-policy matched window
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 13.5,
    xmax = 22.5,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 250,
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Stacked pathway bars
  #
  # reverse = TRUE makes bottom -> top follow pathway_order
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_col(
    data = monthly_pathway_long,
    aes(
      x = month_index,
      y = n,
      fill = pathway
    ),
    width = 0.78,
    position = position_stack(
      reverse = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # All IABP / PEVAD support
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_line(
    data = monthly_pathway_data,
    aes(
      x = month_index,
      y = any_iabp_pevad,
      color =
        "All Initial Listings with IABP/PEVAD Support",
      group = 1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = monthly_pathway_data,
    aes(
      x = month_index,
      y = any_iabp_pevad,
      color =
        "All Initial Listings with IABP/PEVAD Support"
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # All VA-ECMO support
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_line(
    data = monthly_pathway_data,
    aes(
      x = month_index,
      y = va_ecmo,
      color =
        "All Initial Listings with VA-ECMO Support",
      group = 1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = monthly_pathway_data,
    aes(
      x = month_index,
      y = va_ecmo,
      color =
        "All Initial Listings with VA-ECMO Support"
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # September 17, 2025 policy change
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(
    aes(
      xintercept = 13.5,
      linetype =
        "September 17, 2025 Policy Change"
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Policy-window labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 6,
    y = 242,
    label = "Pre-Policy",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 18,
    y = 242,
    label = "Post-Policy",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Bar colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO" =
        "#374e55",

      "Status 1 Exception" =
        "#79af97",

      "Status 2 Standard IABP" =
        "#E0C36A",

      "Status 2 Standard PEVAD" =
        "#df8f44",

      "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD" =
        "#ab3435",

      "Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD" =
        "#80699b",

      "Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes" =
        "#00a1d5"
    ),
    breaks = pathway_order
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Line colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "All Initial Listings with IABP/PEVAD Support" =
        "black",

      "All Initial Listings with VA-ECMO Support" =
        "#c51b7d"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Policy line
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "September 17, 2025 Policy Change" =
        "dashed"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Equal-width monthly x-axis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(
      figure_months
    ),
    labels = format(
      figure_months,
      "%b %Y"
    ),
    limits = c(
      0.5,
      22.5
    ),
    expand = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      250
    ),
    expand = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Initial Listings",
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position =
      "none",

    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 13
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    axis.title =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    plot.margin =
      margin(
        t = 15,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 11. Colored Bar Legend
# Desired order:
#
# 1. Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO
# 2. Status 1 Exception
# 3. Status 2 Standard IABP
# 4. Status 2 Standard PEVAD
# 5. Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD
# 6. Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD
# 7. Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes
# ============================================================

fill_legend_plot <- ggplot(
  monthly_pathway_long,
  aes(
    x = month_index,
    y = n,
    fill = pathway
  )
) +

  geom_col() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Status 1 Standard VA-ECMO" =
        "#374e55",

      "Status 1 Exception" =
        "#79af97",

      "Status 2 Standard IABP" =
        "#E0C36A",

      "Status 2 Standard PEVAD" =
        "#df8f44",

      "Status 2 Exception with IABP/PEVAD" =
        "#ab3435",

      "Status 2 Exception without IABP/PEVAD" =
        "#80699b",

      "Status 3 Standard High-Dose Inotropes" =
        "#00a1d5"
    ),
    breaks = pathway_order
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position =
      "bottom",

    legend.title =
      element_blank(),

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    legend.margin =
      margin(
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0
      )
  )


fill_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  fill_legend_plot
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Device-Line + Policy-Change Legend
# ============================================================

line_policy_legend_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    x = c(
      1,
      2
    ),
    y = c(
      1,
      1
    )
  ),

    x = x,

  )
) +

  geom_line(

    ),

  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      color =

    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    aes(
      xintercept = 1.5,
      linetype =
        "September 17, 2025 Policy Change"
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "All Initial Listings with IABP/PEVAD Support" =
        "black",

      "All Initial Listings with VA-ECMO Support" =
        "#c51b7d"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "September 17, 2025 Policy Change" =
        "dashed"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position =

    legend.box =
      "vertical",

    legend.title =
      element_blank(),

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),

    legend.margin =
      margin(

        0
      )
  )


line_policy_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  line_policy_legend_plot
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Combine Legend Blocks and Final Figure
# ============================================================

combined_legend <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fill_legend,
  line_policy_legend,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(
    2.6,
    1
  ),
  align = "h"
)


final_monthly_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  monthly_allocation_plot,
  combined_legend,

  rel_heights = c(

print(

)
```

``` {r figure 3 transplants}

# ============================================================
# Status 1 and 2 Transplants:
# Standard vs Exception at Time of Transplant
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)


# ============================================================
# 1. Continuous Transplant Cohort
# September 2024 through June 2026
# ============================================================

tx_start <- as.Date("2024-09-01")
tx_end   <- as.Date("2026-06-30")


transplant_cohort_full <- thoracic_data %>%
  mutate(
    TX_DATE = as.Date(TX_DATE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    WL_ORG == "HR",
    INIT_AGE >= 18,
    !is.na(TX_DATE),
    TX_DATE >= tx_start,
    TX_DATE <= tx_end
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Prepare Valid Status 1 Forms
# ============================================================

tx_status1_forms <- thoracic_stat1 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2110
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    transplant_cohort_full %>%
      filter(
        END_STAT == 2110
      ) %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        TX_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT),
    as.Date(UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT) <= TX_DATE
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Classify Status 1 at Transplant
# Latest Timestamp; Exception Takes Precedence if Exact Tie
# ============================================================

tx_status1_latest_timestamp <- tx_status1_forms %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    latest_status1_timestamp =
      max(
        UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


tx_status1_classification <- tx_status1_forms %>%
  inner_join(
    tx_status1_latest_timestamp,
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT ==
      latest_status1_timestamp
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    status1_exception =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    status1_standard =
      !status1_exception &
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    latest_status1_timestamp =
      first(
        latest_status1_timestamp
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Prepare Valid Status 2 Forms
# ============================================================

tx_status2_forms <- thoracic_stat2 %>%
  mutate(
    FORMEFFECTIVEDT = as.Date(FORMEFFECTIVEDT)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !FORMSTATUS %in% invalid_form_statuses,
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_CD == 2120
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    transplant_cohort_full %>%
      filter(
        END_STAT == 2120
      ) %>%
      select(
        WL_ID_CODE,
        TX_DATE
      ),
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT),
    as.Date(UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT) <= TX_DATE
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Classify Status 2 at Transplant
# Latest Timestamp; Exception Takes Precedence if Exact Tie
# ============================================================

tx_status2_latest_timestamp <- tx_status2_forms %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    latest_status2_timestamp =
      max(
        UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


tx_status2_classification <- tx_status2_forms %>%
  inner_join(
    tx_status2_latest_timestamp,
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UNOS_CAND_STAT_DT ==
      latest_status2_timestamp
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    WL_ID_CODE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    status2_exception =
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    status2_standard =
      !status2_exception &
      any(
        EXCEPTION == 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    latest_status2_timestamp =
      first(
        latest_status2_timestamp
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Join Classification to Transplant Cohort
# ============================================================

transplant_exception_analysis <- transplant_cohort_full %>%
  left_join(
    tx_status1_classification,
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tx_status2_classification,
    by = "WL_ID_CODE"
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Coverage Check
# ============================================================

status1_coverage <- transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  filter(
    END_STAT == 2110
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_status1_transplants = n(),
    
    n_with_status1_form =
      sum(
        !is.na(
          latest_status1_timestamp
        )
      ),
    
    pct_with_status1_form =
      100 *
      mean(
        !is.na(
          latest_status1_timestamp
        )
      )
  )

print(
  status1_coverage
)


status2_coverage <- transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  filter(
    END_STAT == 2120
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_status2_transplants = n(),
    
    n_with_status2_form =
      sum(
        !is.na(
          latest_status2_timestamp
        )
      ),
    
    pct_with_status2_form =
      100 *
      mean(
        !is.na(
          latest_status2_timestamp
        )
      )
  )

print(
  status2_coverage
)


# ============================================================
# 8. Create Final Transplant Pathway Categories
# ============================================================

transplant_exception_analysis <- transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    transplant_pathway = case_when(
      
      END_STAT == 2110 &
        status1_exception == TRUE ~
        "Status 1 Exception",
      
      END_STAT == 2110 &
        status1_standard == TRUE ~
        "Status 1 Standard",
      
      END_STAT == 2110 ~
        "Status 1 Unclassified",
      
      END_STAT == 2120 &
        status2_exception == TRUE ~
        "Status 2 Exception",
      
      END_STAT == 2120 &
        status2_standard == TRUE ~
        "Status 2 Standard",
      
      END_STAT == 2120 ~
        "Status 2 Unclassified",
      
      END_STAT %in% c(
        2130,
        2140,
        2150,
        2160
      ) ~
        "Statuses 3-6",
      
      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. Final Classification Counts
# ============================================================

transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  count(
    transplant_pathway,
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  print(
    n = Inf
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Matched Pre/Post Cohort
# ============================================================

transplant_exception_matched <- transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    policy_group = case_when(
      
      TX_DATE >= as.Date("2024-09-17") &
        TX_DATE <= as.Date("2025-06-30") ~
        "Pre",
      
      TX_DATE >= as.Date("2025-09-17") &
        TX_DATE <= as.Date("2026-06-30") ~
        "Post",
      
      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    ),
    
    policy_group = factor(
      policy_group,
      levels = c(
        "Pre",
        "Post"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(policy_group),
    !is.na(transplant_pathway)
  )


# ============================================================
# 11. Total Transplant Volume
# ============================================================

total_transplant_volume <- transplant_exception_matched %>%
  count(
    policy_group,
    name = "n_transplants"
  )

print(
  total_transplant_volume
)


pre_n <- total_transplant_volume %>%
  filter(
    policy_group == "Pre"
  ) %>%
  pull(
    n_transplants
  )

post_n <- total_transplant_volume %>%
  filter(
    policy_group == "Post"
  ) %>%
  pull(
    n_transplants
  )


total_volume_test <- poisson.test(
  x = c(
    pre_n,
    post_n
  ),
  T = c(
    1,
    1
  )
)

print(
  total_volume_test
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Matched Pre/Post Summary
# ============================================================

transplant_exception_summary <- transplant_exception_matched %>%
  count(
    policy_group,
    transplant_pathway,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    policy_group
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_transplants =
      sum(n),
    
    percent =
      100 * n /
      total_transplants
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(
  transplant_exception_summary,
  n = Inf
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Overall 5-Category Pearson Chi-Square Test
# ============================================================

transplant_5cat_analysis <- transplant_exception_matched %>%
  filter(
    transplant_pathway %in% c(
      "Status 1 Standard",
      "Status 1 Exception",
      "Status 2 Standard",
      "Status 2 Exception",
      "Statuses 3-6"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transplant_pathway = factor(
      transplant_pathway,
      levels = c(
        "Status 1 Standard",
        "Status 1 Exception",
        "Status 2 Standard",
        "Status 2 Exception",
        "Statuses 3-6"
      )
    )
  )


transplant_5cat_table <- table(
  transplant_5cat_analysis$policy_group,
  transplant_5cat_analysis$transplant_pathway
)

print(
  transplant_5cat_table
)


overall_transplant_5cat_test <- chisq.test(
  transplant_5cat_table,
  correct = FALSE
)

print(
  overall_transplant_5cat_test
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Individual Pathway Comparisons
# Pearson Chi-Square Without Yates Correction
# ============================================================

transplant_pathway_tests <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    c(
      "Status 1 Standard",
      "Status 1 Exception",
      "Status 2 Standard",
      "Status 2 Exception",
      "Statuses 3-6"
    ),
    function(pathway_name) {
      
      pathway_flag <-
        transplant_exception_matched$
        transplant_pathway ==
        pathway_name
      
      test_result <- chisq.test(
        table(
          transplant_exception_matched$
            policy_group,
          pathway_flag
        ),
        correct = FALSE
      )
      
      tibble(
        transplant_pathway =
          pathway_name,
        
        p_value =
          test_result$p.value
      )
    }
  )
)

print(
  transplant_pathway_tests,
  n = Inf
)


# ============================================================
# 15. Monthly Counts for Figure 3
# ============================================================

monthly_transplant_exception <- transplant_exception_analysis %>%
  filter(
    transplant_pathway %in% c(
      "Status 1 Standard",
      "Status 1 Exception",
      "Status 2 Standard",
      "Status 2 Exception",
      "Statuses 3-6"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transplant_month =
      floor_date(
        TX_DATE,
        unit = "month"
      ),
    
    transplant_pathway = factor(

      levels = c(
        "Statuses 3-6",
        "Status 2 Standard",
        "Status 2 Exception",
        "Status 1 Standard",
        "Status 1 Exception"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    transplant_month,
    transplant_pathway,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    transplant_month = seq(
      as.Date("2024-09-01"),
      as.Date("2026-06-01"),
      by = "1 month"
    ),
    transplant_pathway,
    fill = list(
      n = 0
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 16. Figure 3
# ============================================================

monthly_transplant_exception <- monthly_transplant_exception %>%
  mutate(
    transplant_pathway = factor(
      transplant_pathway,
      levels = c(
        "Status 1 Standard",
        "Status 1 Exception",
        "Status 2 Standard",
        "Status 2 Exception",
        "Statuses 3-6"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Policy-window midpoints for centered labels

pre_policy_midpoint <- as.Date(
  mean(

# ------------------------------------------------------------

pre_policy_midpoint <- as.Date(

    c(
      as.numeric(as.Date("2024-09-17")),
      as.numeric(as.Date("2025-06-30"))
    )
  ),

post_policy_midpoint <- as.Date(

figure3_months <- seq(
```

``` {r table1}
table1_data <- study %>%
  mutate(
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Sex
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    sex = case_when(
      GENDER == "M" ~ "Male",
      GENDER == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c(
        "Male",
        "Female"
      )
    ),

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Race / Ethnicity
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    race = case_when(
      ETHCAT == 1 ~ "White",
      ETHCAT == 2 ~ "Black",
      ETHCAT == 4 ~ "Hispanic/Latino",
      ETHCAT == 5 ~ "Asian",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    race = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(
        "White",
        "Black",
        "Hispanic/Latino",
        "Asian",
        "Other"
      )
    ),

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # BMI Category
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    bmi_category = case_when(
      INIT_BMI_CALC < 18 ~
        "Underweight",

      INIT_BMI_CALC >= 18 &
        INIT_BMI_CALC < 25 ~
        "Normal",

      INIT_BMI_CALC >= 25 &
        INIT_BMI_CALC < 30 ~
        "Overweight",

      INIT_BMI_CALC >= 30 ~
        "Obese",

      TRUE ~
        "Unknown"
    ),
    bmi_category = factor(
      bmi_category,
      levels = c(
        "Normal",
        "Underweight",
        "Overweight",
        "Obese",
        "Unknown"
      )
    ),

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Blood Type
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    blood_type = case_when(
      ABO %in% c(
        "A",
        "A1",
        "A2"
      ) ~ "A",

      ABO %in% c(
        "AB",
        "A1B",
        "A2B"
      ) ~ "AB",

      ABO == "B" ~
        "B",

      ABO == "O" ~
        "O",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    ),
    blood_type = factor(
      blood_type,
      levels = c(
        "O",
        "A",
        "B",
        "AB"
      )
    ),

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Diagnosis
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    diagnosis = case_when(
      THORACIC_DGN > 999 &
        THORACIC_DGN < 1007 ~
        "Dilated Cardiomyopathy, Non-Ischemic",

      THORACIC_DGN == 1007 |
        THORACIC_DGN == 1200 ~
        "Ischemic Cardiomyopathy",

      THORACIC_DGN > 1048 &
        THORACIC_DGN < 1100 ~
        "Restrictive Cardiomyopathy",

      THORACIC_DGN == 1201 ~
        "Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy",

      THORACIC_DGN == 1203 |
        (
          THORACIC_DGN >= 1205 &
            THORACIC_DGN <= 1207
        ) ~
        "Congenital Heart Disease",

      THORACIC_DGN >= 1100 &
        THORACIC_DGN < 1200 ~
        "Re-Heart Transplant",

      TRUE ~
        "Other"
    ),
    diagnosis = factor(
      diagnosis,
      levels = c(
        "Dilated Cardiomyopathy, Non-Ischemic",
        "Ischemic Cardiomyopathy",
        "Restrictive Cardiomyopathy",
        "Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy",
        "Congenital Heart Disease",
        "Re-Heart Transplant",
        "Other"
      )
    ),

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Initial Listing Status
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    initial_status = factor(
      INIT_STAT,
      levels = c(
        2110,
        2120,
        2130,
        2140,
        2150,
        2160,
        2999
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Status 1",
        "Status 2",
        "Status 3",
        "Status 4",
        "Status 5",
        "Status 6",
        "Temporarily Inactive"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Build Table 1
# ============================================================

table1 <- table1_data %>%
  select(
    policy_group,
    INIT_AGE,
    sex,
    race,
    bmi_category,
    blood_type,
    diagnosis,
    initial_status
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = policy_group,
    statistic = list(
      INIT_AGE ~
        "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",

      all_categorical() ~
        "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      INIT_AGE ~
        1,

      all_categorical() ~
        c(
          0,
          1
        )
    ),
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      INIT_AGE ~
        "Age at Listing (Years)",

      sex ~
        "Sex",

      race ~
        "Race/Ethnicity",

      bmi_category ~
        "Body Mass Index",

      blood_type ~
        "Blood Type",

      diagnosis ~
        "Diagnosis",

      initial_status ~
        "Initial Listing Status"
    )
  ) %>%

  add_p(
    test = list(
      INIT_AGE ~
        "wilcox.test",

      all_categorical() ~
        "chisq.test"
    ),
    pvalue_fun = function(x) {
      gtsummary::style_pvalue(
        x,
        digits = 2
      )
    }
  ) %>%

  modify_header(
    label ~
      "**Characteristic**",

    stat_1 ~
      "**Pre-Policy**  \nN = {n}",

    stat_2 ~
      "**Post-Policy**  \nN = {n}",

    p.value ~
      "**P Value**"
  ) %>%

  modify_caption(
    "**Table 1. Characteristics of Adult Heart Transplant Candidates Before and After the September 17, 2025 Policy Change**"
  ) %>%

  bold_labels()
```
